text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Air Shakur has just finished today's
training.

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text: Nope. This isn't gonna cut it.

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text: You head home. I'm gonna keep going.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Air Shakur seems dissatisfied with
something
about her performance, so it
looks like she
intends to do additional
training.

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text: Suit yourself. Just don't get in my way.
choice_data_list: I'll be watching right here until the very end.

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text:
Good evening, Shakur. Trainer. Are you
still
training?

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text: If so, why don't we run together?

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text: Huh? Why do I have to run with you?

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text:
Hehe. Weeell... ♪ I've brought my lap
times down
recently. Don't you want to
get some data?

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text:
Run with me, and you might just see
something
you like. ♪

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text:
Well, aren't you confident? ...If it's just
talk, I'm
outta here.

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text:
And if I'm telling the truth, you'll run
with me?

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text:
Actions speak louder than words. Let's
go.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
And so, Air Shakur does extra training
until the
sun goes down.

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text:
Huh? If I'm just doing what's necessary, I
don't
think you can call it pushing myself
too hard.

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text:
If you want to talk general theory, let's
stick to
the textbooks. Or did you have
an original idea
you wanted to add?

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text: Oh yeah? Like what?
choice_data_list: There are things you can do even without running.

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text:
Well, if it isn't Shakur—just the person I
need.

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text:
Just what I need, another pain in my ass.
What do
you need me specifically for?

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text:
Well, you see, I need to gain an
objective
understanding of my own
running in order to
make progress with
my research.

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text:
If you're finished with your own training,
could I
bother you to record mine?

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text:
Heh... So basically, you really wanna run
right
now.

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text:
You think I don't know that? Aren't I the
one
always collecting data?
choice_data_list: There are things you can learn just by watching.

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text:
I'm going to stay put and watch her run.
It seems
best to focus on data collection
right now.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Rather than push herself too hard at this
point,
Air Shakur takes up a less
strenuous activity.
